## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Hallie1.0_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "I used this app for 20 years and had a premium subscription. The new update is totally frustrating and unworkable. Not being able to see all of my logged food at the same time on one screen anymore was the last straw. I moved on and found something that works much better."
            2. _Jdheiskdbrjsoos_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been using this app for a while now and really hate that barcode scanning is behind a $20/month paywall. Deleting the app and switching to something else. BYE MFP"
            3. _Keritano_, Aug 7, 2026, 2/5: ""Swipe right to log yesterday's meal" does not work anymore, goal setting page has nice updates but is not intuitive - specifically having to toggle recommend calories off. I don't like that I have to do 2 clicks to look at my nutrients. I consider this to be the main reason I use the app so having it be on the third tab over in progress and hidden until nutrients is clicked feels like a lot of friction for a UX perspective. Also just in general salty that you guys moved scan bar code to a premium feature when it used to be a free feature. Placing a free feature behind a paywall after roll out is a bad business model."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _sooooooppphhhhiiiiaaaaa_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "Im never one to leave a bad review. But the update sucks. I have used MFP for over a decade and this is what is finally gonna be pushing me to search for another app. The new update makes tracking 10x more complicated and slows it down. Why change something that wasn’t broken? Why not listen to thousand of dissatisfied longtime users? Please give us an option to revert back."
            2. _theplasticdr_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "New update is absolutely stupid and completely broken the app. So many things ruined, will cancel my membership and leave now. Do not update the app, MFP roll back this stupid update or allow people to use the old layout."
            3. _Zahmed22_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I keep having issues I choose a goal after saving it - I’ll look at the diary and the calories have changed I’ve uninstalled the app and reinstalled no avail"
